rules.title: Who — chỉ người (chủ ngữ)
rules.usage: Thay thế cho danh từ chỉ người, làm chủ ngữ.
examples: The manager who approved the request is on leave.
Employees who work overtime receive extra pay.

rules.title: Whom — chỉ người (tân ngữ)
rules.usage: Thay thế cho danh từ chỉ người, làm tân ngữ.
examples: The candidate whom we interviewed yesterday was excellent.
The client whom you met last week called again.

rules.title: Which — chỉ vật
rules.usage: Thay thế cho danh từ chỉ vật.
examples: The package which arrived this morning is yours.
The system which we installed last month is efficient.

rules.title: Where — chỉ nơi chốn
rules.usage: Thay thế cho danh từ chỉ nơi chốn.
examples: The office where I work is downtown.
This is the factory where the products are made.
